```javascript
import sales from './sales.json' with {type:'json'};

const ISO_DATE_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function isValidIsoDate(s) {
  if (typeof s !== 'string' || !ISO_DATE_RE.test(s)) return false;
  const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number);
  const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
  return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'sales_report',
    description: 'Sum sales amounts between two ISO dates (inclusive).',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        start_date: { type: 'string', description: 'Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD).' },
        end_date: { type: 'string', description: 'Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD).' }
      },
      required: ['start_date', 'end_date'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'sales_report') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  const allowed = new Set(['start_date', 'end_date']);
  for (const k of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(k)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected field: ${k}`);
    }
  }
  const { start_date, end_date } = args;
  if (!isValidIsoDate(start_date)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid start_date: ${start_date}`);
  }
  if (!isValidIsoDate(end_date)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid end_date: ${end_date}`);
  }
  if (start_date > end_date) {
    throw new Error(`start_date (${start_date}) is after end_date (${end_date})`);
  }
  let total = 0;
  let count = 0;
  for (const row of sales) {
    if (row.date >= start_date && row.date <= end_date) {
      total += row.amount;
      count += 1;
    }
  }
  return {
    content: [{
      type: 'text',
      text: `Total: ${total} across ${count} row${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`
    }]
  };
}
```
